name: Edge Glint
description: A short bright arc on a card's border that turns to face the pointer as it comes near.

props.name: spread
props.description: Length of the arc in degrees around the card's centre.

props.name: proximity
props.description: How far outside the card, in pixels, the pointer can be and still light the arc.

props.name: inactiveZone
props.description: Radius of the still area at the centre, as a fraction of half the card's shorter side. The arc fades out while the pointer is inside it.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Thickness of the arc in pixels.

props.name: blur
props.description: Radius in pixels of a soft halo around the arc. 0 draws the arc alone.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colours along the arc, in clockwise order.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the layer, which covers the parent's border box and inherits its radius. Place it inside a relative, rounded container. Other div props are passed through.
